deviations: Code block axes follow the brief: variant single|tabbed|diff × size × tone default|destructive (spec variant default|destructive renamed tone; spec header none|title|tabs replaced by variant + header boolean).
Code block root fill code/bg (brief) instead of spec surface/surface; the head has no fill of its own and sits on code/bg above a border/subtle rule.
Language label is human ('TypeScript') in T.caption text/muted, not the spec T.eyebrow (owner header rule: no mono eyebrow beside a title).
lineNumbers lives on Code line: a parent boolean cannot drive a nested instance boolean, so Code block exposes its Code line rows.
Syntax colours are bound to code/syntax/* (spec said monochrome until the roles existed; they exist). Identifiers text/fg.
Copied state is shown in the review (Copy glyph → check plus an O6 Tooltip 'Copied'), not as a variant.
Chart, Chart block and Donut gain a state axis rest|hover|loading|empty (brief); Chart loading/empty repeat per series only to size the legend skeleton.

Chart tooltip keeps the spec R.float card (surface/raised, border/default, radius/card, effect/shadow-overlay) instead of the O6 ink chip: series 1 is ink in Utility light and its swatch vanishes on the ink chip. Single-value hovers in Chart block and Donut nest the O6 Tooltip itself.
Chart row and Donut legend row use series 1…5 (chart/1…5, brief) instead of spec tone (<tone>/default).
Chart block bar is single-series (ink) on material/track; column compares This week (chart/1) with Last week (chart/2); both carry a Chart legend (brief).
Donut arcs are filled ellipse arc segments (inner radius) rather than stroked arcs; hover pops the segment 4px and floats an O6 Tooltip above the ring (outside the component bounds, like a portal).
Accordion open swaps the glyph to chevron-up instead of rotating chevron-down 180°. Single|multiple is the Accordion type axis; Collapsible is a single disclosure and has no single|multiple.
Collapsible gains state rest|hover|focus|disabled (brief), mapped onto the Button / sm ghost states; content is an INSTANCE_SWAP property.
Carousel previous/next keep radius/control: no 999 override (owner rule against pill literals). Counter added as a boolean beside dots.
Fragment Mono renders '=>' as a ⇒ ligature in Utility code (font feature, not a glyph substitution).
Draft area (label + Badge/Avatar drafts) moved below the new sections, unchanged.
findings: Theme palette collisions (strip): series 1 = each theme's primary, so Brutal chart/1 #ffc53d equals chart/4 #ffc53d, Pixel #faab35 is close to #ffc53d, Cupertino #0d74ce is close to chart/2 #0090ff, Fluent #005fb8 vs #0090ff is weak.
